fieldValues.title: How do affirmations work?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Mechanism today: the owner affirms a suggestion by forking it (`record fork`) into the Affirmed container (5e28aa7e). The fork is a new record, derived-from the suggestion and createdBy the human; the agent's original stays in Suggestions (219dc999) as testimony. Setting aside is a reversible move into Set aside (17006e00), and readers resolve links to the affirmed end through canon(). Example: domain 'Programme coordination' 3576be41 (suggested 2026-10-11) and its fork 346e323e (affirmed 2026-10-16). Counted 2026-11-10: Affirmed holds 379 records (159 problems, 75 remedies, 26 tensions, 25 clusters and others), 370 of them copies of a suggestion; Suggestions holds 691. Where it happens: the srs-web affirmation editor (srs-web#617, closed 2026-10-29), the control room's affirmation editor, the CLI, and Affirmation review meetings; never in chat (vignette 81f2bf49: a chat yes is 'another fake decision'). What an affirmation carries today: an affirmed remedy is a recorded ruling for a group's mandate (2637af0a); affirmed clusters are the owner's (2800bea0); an affirmed problem is grounded in an affirmed domain (ee59155b); confidence grades care and does not gate work (9d50126b); nothing may affirm on the owner's behalf (c373c2c1). The owner's experience of it: "a strange overhead... We have duplicate records" (65efdece, 10-30); "Affirmation out of context breaks my ability to see the nuance. So I just click accept most of the time" (c020fd77, 11-04); "Affirmations are anchors. So are the vignettes. AI brings the coherence inbetween" (8b5b80d6, 11-06); "The affirmation layer is very important. But it's also too difficult and so we never get there" (96f88dd0, 11-06). The Rebel, reviewing the session-agenda exercises on 2026-11-10, found that many apparent duplicates are a suggestion and its affirmed fork, and asked whether affirming should change a record's standing or create a second record; the owner called that question very important and asked for one clear open exercise on how affirmations work (762769e3).
fieldValues.tensions: 1. Standing against copy: forking keeps the agent's testimony intact, but every affirmed thing exists twice, edges split across both ends, every reader needs canon(), and the copies read as drift ('many versions of this wheel'). 2. Important against too difficult: the owner holds affirmation as the human anchor, yet at today's volume and out of context it becomes clicking. 3. Affirmation against confidence: the owner sees the workflow moving towards confidence built from relationships (1110c523; c8b12a7b, 'there is no fixed truth that will be affirmed'), and 9d50126b says confidence does not gate, yet mandates still rest on affirmed remedies (2637af0a). 4. Only the owner against agents for their own problems: the rule is that nothing affirms on the owner's behalf, but the owner said 'Agents should probably be able to affirm problems where they are the audience!' (d83cd13c) and remedy 4bf3a3ac proposes it. 5. Rare anchors against broad coverage: 'affirmation is rarer than we expect' (8b5b80d6), against 379 affirmed records. 6. A separate layer against affirming where one writes: a tick or a bin in the essay (67459d40, exercise fafd9091) and affirm-in-context (remedy 2910ac1e), against the layer kept apart from conversation.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: 1. Does affirming change the standing of the existing record (a state, a layer membership, or an attestation that points at it), or create a second record, as today? 2. What does an affirmation assert, and is it relative to a boundary ('every statement and affirmation exists only relative to a boundary', a2225a2a)? 3. Which records need affirmation at all, and which acts must stay the owner's office whatever the confidence (exercises 73be203b, 9935bc3f)? 4. Who may affirm: only the owner, or also an agent for a problem whose holder is an agent persona? 5. Where and in what unit does affirming happen so that it is judgement, not clicking: one record, a whole story, a domain set up in one act (exercises 7441dcab, 179676eb)? 6. How do affirmation and confidence relate, and when is that decided (exercises ab9acc60, 1fe6e95f, c3ba3e63)? 7. What happens to the copies that exist now (exercise 7b6cd50c)?
fieldValues.blocking: Merging the duplicate domains, remedies and problems waits on question 1, or the duplicates grow back with the next affirmation round. Decisions that rest on 'affirmed' (2637af0a, 2800bea0, ee59155b) mean whatever question 1 settles. The handbook and the workspace CLAUDE.md still describe the affirmation editor as unbuilt, though srs-web#617 closed on 2026-10-29.
fieldValues.next_action: This is the umbrella for the affirmation exercises in 'Open exercises from affirmation and confidence'; each narrower exercise answers one of its questions. Pass it to agents for comment in declared stances (decision 5f7ec370). Take question 1 first: list every reader of Affirmed membership and of derived-from (as 7b6cd50c proposes), then compare forking (today), a change of standing on the original, and an attestation record pointing at the original by what each costs those readers and the owner. Review it together with ab9acc60 before decision 77e04b19's revisit on 2026-11-21.
